meta.title: MediosVerifica — Spanish Media Verification
meta.description: We evaluate the reliability and neutrality of Spanish media outlets with data, evidence and transparency.

hero.title: How much can you trust your news source?
hero.subtitle: We analyze the reliability and neutrality of Spanish media with objective criteria, documented evidence and full transparency.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.step1Description: We evaluate each outlet with 25 objective criteria divided into reliability and neutrality.
howItWorks.step2Description: Each score includes a detailed justification and links to supporting evidence.
howItWorks.step3Description: Criteria are weighted by importance to generate a transparent final grade.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.subtitle: How we evaluate media outlets
methodology.reliabilityDescription: Measures the outlet's ability to be truthful and stick to proven facts.
methodology.neutralityDescription: Measures balance, ideological honesty and absence of emotional manipulation.
methodology.weightsDescription: Each category has a specific weight in the final grade.
methodology.gradeA: Reliable — The outlet meets reliability and neutrality standards, following good journalistic practices.
methodology.gradeB: Improvable — The outlet is reliable and reasonably neutral, though it has areas for improvement.
methodology.gradeC: With reservations — The outlet has positive aspects, but some issues require attention.
methodology.gradeD: Serious — The outlet is very uneven, with significant issues that deserve consideration.
methodology.gradeE: Very serious — The outlet raises very serious reliability or neutrality concerns.
